feature: Add npub Identifier Support to Nostr Notifications
workflow_rationale: This is a new capability being added to an existing Nostr notification system. It requires backend logic for npub detection and NIP-65 relay fetching, modifications to the notification dispatch flow, UI updates for clarity, and new tests.

phases.name: Backend Nostr Service Extension
phases.description: Add npub format detection and NIP-65 relay fetching functions to the nostr service

subtasks.description: Add is_npub_format() helper function to detect npub vs NIP-05 identifiers

verification.command: cd /Users/constantin/Code/lnbits && poetry run python -c "from lnbits.core.services.nostr import is_npub_format; print(is_npub_format('npub1qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqq7l6upz') == True); print(is_npub_format('user@domain.com') == False)"

subtasks.notes: Added is_npub_format() helper function that checks if an identifier starts with "npub1" prefix. Function returns True for npub format, False for NIP-05 format (user@domain.com). All tests pass.

subtasks.description: Add fetch_nip65_relays() function to query bootstrap relays for kind:10002 events
subtasks.notes: Added fetch_nip65_relays() function that queries bootstrap relays for kind:10002 events (NIP-65). Function extracts write-capable relays from the event tags and returns fallback relays if no NIP-65 event is found. Also added BOOTSTRAP_RELAYS and FALLBACK_RELAYS constants. Syntax verified, committed.

verification.command: cd /Users/constantin/Code/lnbits && poetry run python -c "from lnbits.core.services.nostr import fetch_nip65_relays, BOOTSTRAP_RELAYS; print('fetch_nip65_relays' in dir()); print('BOOTSTRAP_RELAYS' in dir())"

phases.name: Backend Notification Dispatch Update
phases.description: Update send_nostr_notification to detect npub format and route to appropriate relay fetching logic

subtasks.description: Update send_nostr_notification() to detect npub and use NIP-65 relay fetching
subtasks.notes: Updated send_nostr_notification() to detect npub format and use NIP-65 relay fetching. Added imports for is_npub_format, fetch_nip65_relays, and normalize_public_key. The function now handles both npub and NIP-05 identifiers appropriately.

phases.name: Frontend UI Update
phases.description: Update i18n translation to clarify that both npub and NIP-05 formats are accepted

subtasks.description: Update English i18n translation for notifications_nostr_identifier_desc to mention npub support
subtasks.notes: Updated notifications_nostr_identifier_desc translation from 'Nip5 identifier to send notifications to' to 'Nostr identifier (NIP-05 or npub) to send notifications to'. Verification passed.

phases.name: Unit Tests
phases.description: Add unit tests for npub format detection and NIP-65 relay fetching

subtasks.description: Create unit tests for is_npub_format() and npub validation
subtasks.notes: Created tests/unit/test_nostr.py with comprehensive unit tests for is_npub_format() and validate_pub_key(). Tests cover valid npub formats, NIP-05 identifiers, invalid strings, edge cases, and pubkey validation.

subtasks.description: Create unit tests for fetch_nip65_relays() with mocked relay responses
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive unit tests for fetch_nip65_relays() with mocked WebSocket responses. Tests cover: successful NIP-65 relay discovery, read-only relay filtering, fallback to default relays (no event, empty relays, connection error, timeout), retry logic across multiple bootstrap relays, malformed event handling, and verifying fallback returns a copy. All tests use unittest.mock to mock create_connection and WebSocket responses.
